verses.original: אִמְר֥וּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְלַאֲחֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם רֻחָֽמָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im·rū la·’ă·ḥê·ḵem ‘am·mî wə·la·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯê·ḵem ru·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Say of your brothers My people and of your sisters My loved one
verses.literalPt: Dize a vossos irmãos: Meu-Povo; e as vossas irmãs: Favor.

verses.original: רִ֤יבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם֙ רִ֔יבוּ כִּֽי־ הִיא֙ לֹ֣א אִשְׁתִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א אִישָׁ֑הּ וְתָסֵ֤ר זְנוּנֶ֙יהָ֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יה וְנַאֲפוּפֶ֖יהָ מִבֵּ֥ין שָׁדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: rî·ḇū ḇə·’im·mə·ḵem rî·ḇū kî- hî lō ’iš·tî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō ’î·šāh wə·ṯā·sêr zə·nū·ne·hā mip·på̄·nɛh wə·na·’ă·p̄ū·p̄e·hā mib·bên šā·ḏe·hā
verses.literal: Rebuke your mother rebuke her for she is not My wife and I am not her husband Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts
verses.literalPt: Contendei com vossa mãe, contendei, porque ela não é minha esposa, nem sou eu seu esposo. Tire ela da sua face as suas fornicações e, dentre os seus peitos, os seus adultérios;

verses.original: פֶּן־ אַפְשִׁיטֶ֣נָּה עֲרֻמָּ֔ה וְהִ֨צַּגְתִּ֔יהָ כְּי֖וֹם הִוָּֽלְדָ֑הּ וְשַׂמְתִּ֣יהָ כַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְשַׁתִּ֙הָ֙ כְּאֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֔ה וַהֲמִתִּ֖יהָ בַּצָּמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: pen- ’ap̄·šî·ṭen·nāh ‘ă·rum·māh wə·hiṣ·ṣaḡ·tî·hā kə·yō·wm hiw·wā·lə·ḏāh wə·śam·tî·hā ḵam·miḏ·bār wə·šat·ti·hā kə·’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh wa·hă·mit·tî·hā baṣ·ṣā·mā
verses.literal: Otherwise I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land and I will let her die of thirst
verses.literalPt: para que eu não a despoje, deixando-a nua, e a ponha como no dia em que nasceu, e a faça como um deserto, e a torne como uma terra árida, e a mate à sede.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בָּנֶ֖יהָ לֹ֣א אֲרַחֵ֑ם כִּֽי־ בְנֵ֥י זְנוּנִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bā·ne·hā lō ’ă·ra·ḥêm kî- ḇə·nê zə·nū·nîm hêm·māh
verses.literal: I will have no compassion on her children because they are the children of adultery
verses.literalPt: Até de seus filhos não terei misericórdia, porque são filhos de fornicação.

verses.original: כִּ֤י זָֽנְתָה֙ אִמָּ֔ם הֹבִ֖ישָׁה הֽוֹרָתָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֤י מְאַהֲבַי֙ נֹתְנֵ֤י לַחְמִי֙ וּמֵימַ֔י צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י שַׁמְנִ֖י וְשִׁקּוּיָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî zā·nə·ṯāh ’im·mām hō·ḇî·šāh hō·w·rā·ṯām kî ’ā·mə·rāh ’ê·lə·ḵāh ’a·ḥă·rê mə·’a·hă·ḇay nō·ṯə·nê laḥ·mî ū·mê·may ṣam·rî ū·p̄iš·tî šam·nî wə·šiq·qū·yāy
verses.literal: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace For she thought I will go after my lovers who give me bread and water wool and linen oil and drink
verses.literalPt: Pois sua mãe se prostituiu; aquela que os concebeu houve-se torpemente, porque disse: Irei após os meus amantes, que me dão o meu pão e a minha água, a minha lã e o meu linho, o meu azeite e a minha bebida.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִי־ שָׂ֥ךְ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּ֖ךְ בַּסִּירִ֑ים וְגָֽדַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ גְּדֵרָ֔הּ וּנְתִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א תִמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî- śāḵ ’eṯ- dar·kêḵ bas·sî·rîm wə·ḡā·ḏar·tî ’eṯ- gə·ḏê·rāh ū·nə·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā lō ṯim·ṣā
verses.literal: Therefore behold I will hedge up her path with thorns I will enclose her with a wall - so she cannot find her way
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que te vou cercar o caminho com espinhos e levantarei contra ela uma sebe, de sorte que ela não ache as suas veredas.

verses.original: וְרִדְּפָ֤ה אֶת־ מְאַהֲבֶ֙יהָ֙ וְלֹֽא־ תַשִּׂ֣יג אֹתָ֔ם וּבִקְשָׁ֖תַם וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָ֑א וְאָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֤ה וְאָשׁ֙וּבָה֙ אֶל־ אִישִׁ֣י הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לִ֛י אָ֖ז מֵעָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rid·də·p̄āh ’eṯ- mə·’a·hă·ḇe·hā wə·lō- ṯaś·śîḡ ’ō·ṯām ū·ḇiq·šā·ṯam wə·lō ṯim·ṣā wə·’ā·mə·rāh ’ê·lə·ḵāh wə·’ā·šū·ḇāh ’el- ’î·šî hā·ri·šō·wn kî ṭō·wḇ lî ’āz mê·‘āt·tāh
verses.literal: She will pursue her lovers but not catch them she will seek them but not find them Then she will say . . . I will return to my first husband for then I was better off . . . than now
verses.literalPt: Ela irá em seguimento dos seus amantes, porém não os alcançará; ela os buscará, porém não os achará; então, dirá: Irei e voltarei para o meu primeiro marido, porque então me ia melhor do que agora.

verses.original: וְהִיא֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְעָ֔ה כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔הּ הַדָּגָ֖ן וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְכֶ֨סֶף הִרְבֵּ֥יתִי לָ֛הּ וְזָהָ֖ב עָשׂ֥וּ לַבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hî lō yā·ḏə·‘āh kî ’ā·nō·ḵî nā·ṯat·tî lāh had·dā·ḡān wə·hat·tî·rō·wōš wə·hay·yiṣ·hār wə·ḵe·sep̄ hir·bê·ṯî lāh wə·zā·hāḇ ‘ā·śū lab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: For she does not acknowledge that it was I who gave her grain new wine and oil who lavished on her silver and gold which they crafted for Baal
verses.literalPt: Pois ela não sabia que fui eu o que lhe dei o grão, e o mosto, e o óleo e que lhe multipliquei a prata e o ouro, de que fizeram a Baal.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָשׁ֔וּב וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י דְגָנִי֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וְתִירוֹשִׁ֖י בְּמֽוֹעֲד֑וֹ וְהִצַּלְתִּי֙ צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י לְכַסּ֖וֹת אֶת־ עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·šūḇ wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ḏə·ḡā·nî bə·‘it·tōw wə·ṯî·rō·wō·šî bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏōw wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tî ṣam·rî ū·p̄iš·tî lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ’eṯ- ‘er·wā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Therefore I will take back . . . My grain in its time and My new wine in its season I will take away My wool and linen which were given to cover her nakedness
verses.literalPt: Por isso, tornarei a tomar o meu grão a seu tempo e o meu mosto a seu tempo e arrebatarei a minha lã e o meu linho, que deviam cobrir a sua nudez.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲגַלֶּ֥ה אֶת־ נַבְלֻתָ֖הּ לְעֵינֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹֽא־ יַצִּילֶ֥נָּה מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḡal·leh ’eṯ- naḇ·lu·ṯāh lə·‘ê·nê mə·’a·hă·ḇe·hā wə·’îš lō- yaṣ·ṣî·len·nāh mî·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: And then I will expose her lewdness in the sight of her lovers and no one will deliver her out of My hands
verses.literalPt: Agora, descobrirei a sua vileza à vista dos seus amantes, e ninguém a livrará da minha mão.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ כָּל־ מְשׂוֹשָׂ֔הּ חַגָּ֖הּ חָדְשָׁ֣הּ וְשַׁבַּתָּ֑הּ וְכֹ֖ל מוֹעֲדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî kāl- mə·śō·w·śāh ḥag·gāh ḥā·ḏə·šāh wə·šab·bat·tāh wə·ḵōl mō·w·‘ă·ḏāh
verses.literal: I will put an end to all her exultation her feasts New Moons and Sabbaths all her appointed feasts
verses.literalPt: Também farei cessar toda a sua alegria, as suas festas, as suas luas novas, os seus sábados e todas as suas assembleias solenes.

verses.original: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֗י גַּפְנָהּ֙ וּתְאֵ֣נָתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְרָ֗ה אֶתְנָ֥ה הֵ֙מָּה֙ לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתְנוּ־ לִ֖י מְאַֽהֲבָ֑י וְשַׂמְתִּ֣ים לְיַ֔עַר וַאֲכָלָ֖תַם חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·šim·mō·ṯî gap̄·nāh ū·ṯə·’ê·nā·ṯāh ’ă·šer ’ā·mə·rāh ’eṯ·nāh hêm·māh lî ’ă·šer nā·ṯə·nū- lî mə·’a·hă·ḇāy wə·śam·tîm lə·ya·‘ar wa·’ă·ḵā·lā·ṯam ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: I will destroy her vines and fig trees which she thinks are the wages paid by her lovers So I will make them into a thicket and the beasts of the field will devour them
verses.literalPt: Assolarei as suas vides e as suas figueiras, de que ela tem dito: Estas são o meu aluguel que me deram os meus amantes; delas farei um bosque, e os animais do campo as devorarão.

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עָלֶ֗יהָ אֶת־ יְמֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּקְטִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וַתַּ֤עַד נִזְמָהּ֙ וְחֶלְיָתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאֹתִ֥י שָׁכְחָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘ā·le·hā ’eṯ- yə·mê hab·bə·‘ā·lîm ’ă·šer taq·ṭîr lā·hem wat·ta·‘aḏ niz·māh wə·ḥel·yā·ṯāh wat·tê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rê mə·’a·hă·ḇe·hā wə·’ō·ṯî šā·ḵə·ḥāh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will punish her for the days of the Baals when she burned incense to them . . . when she adorned herself with rings and jewelry and went after her lovers But Me she forgot declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Sobre ela, visitarei os dias de Baalins, aos quais queimava incenso, quando se enfeitava com as suas arrecadas e as suas joias e, indo após os seus amantes, se esquecia de mim, diz Jeová.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְפַתֶּ֔יהָ וְהֹֽלַכְתִּ֖יהָ הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְדִבַּרְתִּ֖י עַל לִבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·p̄at·te·hā wə·hō·laḵ·tî·hā ham·miḏ·bār wə·ḏib·bar·tî ʿal lib·bāh
verses.literal: Therefore behold I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness and speak to her tenderly
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que eu a atrairei, e a levarei para o deserto, e lhe falarei ao coração.

verses.original: וְנָתַ֨תִּי לָ֤הּ אֶת־ כְּרָמֶ֙יהָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְאֶת־ עֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְפֶ֣תַח תִּקְוָ֑ה וְעָ֤נְתָה שָּׁ֙מָּה֙ כִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וִּכְי֖וֹם עֲלֹתָ֥הּ מֵאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lāh ’eṯ- kə·rā·me·hā miš·šām wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·meq ‘ā·ḵō·wr lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ tiq·wāh wə·‘ā·nə·ṯāh šām·māh kî·mê nə·‘ū·re·hā wiḵ·yōm ‘ă·lō·ṯāh mê·’e·reṣ- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: There I will give back her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth as in the day she came up out of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Dali, lhe darei as suas vinhas e o vale de Acor, para uma porta de esperança; ali, cantará ela como nos dias da sua mocidade e como no dia em que subiu da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־ הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה תִּקְרְאִ֖י אִישִׁ֑י וְלֹֽא־ תִקְרְאִי־ לִ֥י ע֖וֹד בַּעְלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm- ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh tiq·rə·’î ’î·šî wə·lō- ṯiq·rə·’î- lî ‘ō·wḏ ba‘·lî
verses.literal: In that day declares the LORD you will call Me my Husband and no longer call Me my Master
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, diz Jeová, me chamarás Meu Marido e nunca mais me chamarás Meu Baal.

verses.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֛י אֶת־ שְׁמ֥וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֖ים מִפִּ֑יהָ וְלֹֽא־ יִזָּכְר֥וּ ע֖וֹד בִּשְׁמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ’eṯ- šə·mō·wṯ hab·bə·‘ā·lîm mip·pî·hā wə·lō- yiz·zā·ḵə·rū ‘ō·wḏ biš·mām
verses.literal: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals no longer will their names be invoked
verses.literalPt: Pois da sua boca tirarei os nomes dos Baalins, e os seus nomes não serão mais mencionados.

verses.original: וְכָרַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֤ם בְּרִית֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עִם־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְעִם־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וְקֶ֨שֶׁת וְחֶ֤רֶב וּמִלְחָמָה֙ אֶשְׁבּ֣וֹר מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִשְׁכַּבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·rat·tî lā·hem bə·rîṯ bay·yō·wm ha·hū ‘im- ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh wə·‘im- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·re·meś hā·’ă·ḏā·māh wə·qe·šeṯ wə·ḥe·reḇ ū·mil·ḥā·māh ’eš·bō·wr min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hiš·kaḇ·tîm lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ
verses.literal: On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that crawl on the ground And I will abolish bow and sword and battle in the land and will make them lie down in safety
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, far-lhes-ei uma aliança com os animais do campo, e com as aves do céu, e com os répteis da terra; da terra quebrarei o arco, e a espada, e a guerra e fá-los-ei deitar em segurança.

verses.original: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִי֙ בְּצֶ֣דֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחֶ֖סֶד וּֽבְרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·raś·tîḵ lî lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·’ê·raś·tîḵ lî bə·ṣe·ḏeq ū·ḇə·miš·pāṭ ū·ḇə·ḥe·seḏ ū·ḇə·ra·ḥă·mîm
verses.literal: So I will betroth you to Me forever I will betroth you in righteousness and justice in loving devotion and compassion
verses.literalPt: Desposar-te-ei comigo para sempre, sim, desposar-te-ei comigo em justiça, e em juízo, e em benignidade, e em misericórdias.

verses.original: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·raś·tîḵ lî be·’ĕ·mū·nāh wə·yā·ḏa·‘at ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And I will betroth you in faithfulness and you will know the LORD
verses.literalPt: Desposar-te-ei comigo em fidelidade, e conhecerás a Jeová.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶעֱנֶ֖ה אֶת־ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’e·‘ĕ·neh nə·’um- Yah·weh ’e·‘ĕ·neh ’eṯ- haš·šā·mā·yim wə·hêm ya·‘ă·nū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: On that day I will respond declares the LORD I will respond to the heavens and they will respond to the earth
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, responderei, diz Jeová, responderei aos céus, e estes responderão à terra;

verses.original: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ תַּעֲנֶ֔ה אֶת־ הַדָּגָ֖ן וְאֶת־ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְאֶת־ הַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶֽת־ יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ta·‘ă·neh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḡān wə·’eṯ- hat·tî·rō·wōš wə·’eṯ- hay·yiṣ·hār wə·hêm ya·‘ă·nū ’eṯ- yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: And the earth will respond to the grain to the new wine and oil and they will respond to Jezreel
verses.literalPt: a terra responderá ao grão, ao mosto e ao azeite, e estes responderão a Jezreel.

verses.original: וּזְרַעְתִּ֤יהָ לִּי֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וְאָמַרְתִּ֤י לְלֹֽא־ עַמִּי֙ עַמִּי־ אַ֔תָּה וְה֖וּא יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·ra‘·tî·hā lî bā·’ā·reṣ wə·ri·ḥam·tî ’eṯ- lō ru·ḥā·māh wə·’ā·mar·tî lə·lō- ‘am·mî ‘am·mî- ’at·tāh wə·hū yō·mar ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: And I will sow her as My own in the land and I will have compassion on No Compassion I will say to those called Not My People You are My people and they will say You are my God
verses.literalPt: Semeá-la-ei para mim na terra e terei misericórdia daquela que não havia recebido misericórdia; direi aos que não eram o meu povo: Tu és o meu povo; e eles dirão: Tu és o meu Deus.
